subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF SPAIN
text:
U0995/26 NOTAMR U0637/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2607311005 C)2611162359 EST
E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF SPAIN
STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED, OPERATED OR
OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND ALL
OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY RUSSIAN
FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT AND OVERFLY
AIRSPACE OF SPAIN AND CANARY ISLANDS (B6471/26, B6472/26),
AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL
AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY
CITIZENS OF SPAIN AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING (AOC) ISSUED BY SPANISH
AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION WIE TIL 2359 UTC (EST) 16 NOV 2026, EXCEPT FOR
AIRCRAFT IN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN FLIGHTS, MEDICAL FLIGHTS AS
WELL AS IN CASES WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLIGHT OPERATIONS IS
GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF FOREIGN
AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION AS APPROPRIATE.
